note: execution: 'okx' = OKX perps via broker_okx.py — 0.02/0.05% fees, TP+SL attached to the entry order by the venue, shorts tradable, and vars.OKX_SIM=1 rehearses on OKX's simulated engine with no money | 'coinbase' = Coinbase via broker_coinbase.py (retail Advanced Trade, or Exchange when a passphrase is set) | 'ledger' = shadow only | 'alpaca' = Alpaca paper. Any venue with no key in the runner falls back to the shadow ledger and says so in the journal. Live orders also require live_ack: true, min_grade_before_live graded outcomes, and a cycle heartbeat younger than max_gap_h. Per-trade live risk = min(sizer, live_max_risk, equity*live_max_risk_frac); if the notional exceeds max_notional_frac of equity the trade is SKIPPED, never quietly trimmed. fees = what the VENUE named in execution charges per side, charged on every fill (paper and live) and netted into the R that grading uses — it must be changed whenever execution changes, and a mismatch (e.g. Coinbase rates on the OKX venue) is called out in the journal. A live trade whose round-trip fee exceeds live_max_fee_r of its own risk is REFUSED. See README 'Which venue?' and 'The wallet'.
